d: The Director of Corporate Affairs will lead the development and execution of strategies to foster strong relationships with key government entities and stakeholders, and align initiatives with the company’s vision, mission, and goals. This role requires strategic leadership across corporate affairs, government relations, stakeholder engagement and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG).
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Corporate Communications, or a related field. Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA), or a related discipline is preferred.
Professional certifications in Corporate Governance, ESG, Public Affairs, or Stakeholder Management are an added advantage.
Extensive professional experience in corporate affairs, government relations, regulatory affairs or stakeholder management, preferably within the real estate, tourism or development sectors.
Strong understanding of Omani legislation, government procedures and relevant regulatory frameworks.
Knowledge of corporate governance, ESG, CSR and ICV principles and requirements.
Proficient in Microsoft Office, Excel, Word and Outlook.
r: Develop and implement long- and short-term corporate affairs communication strategies and action plans to ensure alignment with the organization’s strategy.
Manage internal corporate communications, including maintaining a monthly calendar.
Follow up on monthly projects with each Department Head.
Provide the CEO with regular project approval updates.
Develop and manage the annual budget for the department in line with the organizational business plan
Develop and maintain effective relationships with all government officials.
Coordinate with various departments and colleagues and provide input to local officials.
Provide operational support for legislative processes and ensure compliance with public policies and objectives.
Ensure all company requirements and government approvals are met, including labor clearance, employment visas, client visas, renewals, permits & licenses, and any other necessary permits.
Liaise and follow up with senior authorities to facilitate the timely fulfilment of all company requests.
Develop relationships with public officials and implement public policies to achieve organizational objectives.
Prepare summaries and analyze various legislation and materials obtained from high-ranking officials and regulatory bodies.

Monitor and stay informed of In-Country Value (ICV) legislation, regulations, and policy developments, providing guidance and support to relevant teams to ensure compliance and alignment with corporate objectives.
Supports the insurance administration process, including renewals and claims for property insurance, medical insurance and other related insurance to the company.
Develop, oversee, and implement the company’s ESG and Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) strategies, initiatives, and programmes.
Promote sustainable business practices and social impact initiatives that align with the company’s values, strategic objectives, and commitment to responsible corporate citizenship.
Monitor ESG and CSR performance, ensuring compliance with applicable standards, regulations, and corporate governance requirements.
Evaluate and report on the progress, effectiveness, and impact of ESG and CSR initiatives to relevant stakeholders.
Set overall KPIs and targets for the department in line with organizational performance targets and ensure their achievement
Oversee and manage workforce planning activities for the department.
Delegate tasks to staff to ensure a balance between workload and skill availability within the department.
Monitor staff performance within the department on an ongoing basis and ensure that performance reviews are conducted.
Lead and direct the Government Affairs team to deliver comprehensive services to the business.
Identify training and development priorities for the department to ensure all staff are adequately skilled to perform their roles and responsibilities.
Coach and mentor staff, focusing especially on developing the capabilities to create a motivated, high-performance team.
Communicate clearly and directly with employees regarding performance expectations, productivity, and accountability.

d: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
We are looking for a Sales Executive to join our team in Qatar and be part of our growth.

You will be responsible for onboarding new restaurant partners to the platform, managing the full sales cycle from lead generation to closing deals, expanding our network and driving growth in your assigned region.
Identify and acquire new restaurant partners through cold calls, field visits, and networking.
Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline to achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
Present Talabat’s value proposition, negotiate contracts, and close partnership agreements.
Ensure a smooth onboarding process for partners, coordinating with internal teams to activate listings.
Encourage clients/ restaurants to upload pictures of their menu on Talabat.
Implement promotions, coupons and vouchers to boost and generate sales growth.
Collect market intelligence and competitor activity to refine sales strategies.
Maintain accurate records of all sales activities and client interactions using CRM tools.
Provide feedback from partners to help improve our platform and services.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce or another related field
1–3 years of experience in field sales, preferably with e-commerce, Q-comm or FMCG
Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
Strong communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM systems is a plus (e.g., Salesforce).
Must be a native Arabic speaker.
A valid driving license and a car is a must.
